description: This is a unit test class for the LoginLogDao within the OrangeHRM authentication module. It tests saving login log entries, mocks dependencies, and verifies that login logs are correctly created and stored.

classes.name: LoginLogDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing LoginLogDao functionality, specifically saving login logs and verifying their contents.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LoginLogDao object before each test.

methods.name: testSaveLoginLog
methods.description: Tests the saveLoginLog method of LoginLogDao by mocking the DateTimeHelperService, creating a LoginLog object, and asserting that the save operation returns expected values and correctly sets login details.
